summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with good feature engineering and cross-validation, but suffers from data leakage. By concatenating the train and test sets before applying TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding, test set statistics bleed into the training data. Additionally, the agent uses a random cross-validation split on temporal data and employs a naive equal-weight ensemble without tuning.
